title.zh: 从单变量主弧逼近到二元系数误差
title.en: Propagate major-arc approximation into the binary coefficient

description.zh: 沿用有理频率附近的 Λ 指数和估计，量化平方、积分和多个弧段累加的损失。最后仍须单独证明逐点次弧下界。
description.en: Start with the Mangoldt estimate near a rational frequency. Track the cost of squaring and integrating across arcs; pointwise minor-arc cancellation remains open.
